objects.name: Analytic 1716
objects.description: For Android, detect Encrypted Channel from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes high-entropy blob (Shannon entropy > $EntropyThreshold$) to local staging path immediately before outbound transmission — encrypted staging artifact confirms app-layer encryption occurred]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

Default 7.0 bits Shannon entropy for staged file. Calibrate from legitimate app file baseline. Files above threshold are likely encrypted or compressed.
